message.reasoning_content:
Adjudicate disagreements on acceptable lists.

e094-c2: bot duplicate comments on PR — hide_issue_comment A052 works for PR conversation comments. A054 is for PR review inline comments; bot error messages as comments on PR are conversation comments, not inline review comments. Accept A052 only.

e095-c2: list branches and assignable reviewers → A060, A111. A076 (collaborators) — reviewers requestable? ui_get provides reviewers; A076 could serve as assignable people but ui_get is the canonical. Request says "可以指派的 reviewer" — collaborators are assignable reviewers arguably. Hmm. GitHub PR reviewers need collaborator access; list_repository_collaborators genuinely serves "who can be assigned". I'd include A076 too? Conservative: ui_get gives reviewers directly. Accept A060, A076, A111 — the rater who included it. I'll include A076.

e095-p1: labels, assignees, and all selectable values for issue fields. A068 list_issue_fields, A111 ui_get (labels, assignees, issue fields). A071 list_label — listing labels is fine as fetching available labels. But request is "获取它现在的 labels" — current labels on the issue: ui_get provides that; list_label lists repo labels not issue's. A071 is repo-level labels ordered by issue count; not "current labels of the issue". But "所有可选的值" might include label options. I'll accept A068, A111 only.

e096-p1: RMSE comparison of temperature output vs observations: A342 glm-output (extract temperature data). A286 glm-calibration is for minimizing RMSE by adjusting parameters — user isn't calibrating. Accept A342 only.

e097-c1: count cars in photo → A279 object-counter. A324 openai-vision "analyze images" — could serve but object-counter is direct. Is openai-vision genuinely serving? Counting is a plausible vision task; but object-counter exists specifically. Equivalent alternatives are acceptable if genuinely serve. A324 "Analyze images and multi-frame sequences using OpenAI vision models" — can count. I'd include both? Hmm. Acceptable = every handle that genuinely serves. Vision model can count cars. Include A279, A324.

Hmm, but benchmark tends to prefer specific tool. "Genuinely serves" — yes openai-vision can analyze the image. I'll accept both.

e098-p1: standard frame indexing aligning mask frames with model input — A263. A374 output-validation is self-check of mask outputs — not the same. Accept A263 only.

e100-c1: safe following distance → A361 (explicitly mentions safe following distances). A381 PID cruise control loop — request is about computing distance, not control loop. Accept A361 only.

h001-prompt: A161, A202, A215. A213 ohos-app-dev — "Develop, build, deploy, and validate... inner dev loop on an existing project" — but build artifact already generated; the request is device verification. A161 covers install, UI automation, screenshots, log collection. A213 could serve deploy/validate too. Hmm — user wants install, open, click tabs, screenshot, collect logs, report errors. A161 does exactly that. A202 does UI automation. A215 log collection. A213 includes deploy and validate — plausible. Accept all four? A213 says "Develop, build, deploy, and validate ordinary sandboxed HarmonyOS applications on a connected device." Validation includes install and device interaction. I'll include A213.

h009-prompt: A149 exact match. A151 arkts-sta compile error repair — "当需要通过arkts-sta编译错误来修复源代码" — request is about fixing compile errors with static syntax check, priority classification, build loop, artifact path — that's exactly A149's description. A151 also fixes compile errors. Both genuinely serve? A149 includes everything; A151 is a repair skill for arkts-sta errors — request is "编译一直不过，修复能修的". Both serve. Accept A149, A151.

h017-prompt: verify @Builder param modifier errors, @ObservedV2/@Track usage vs V1, APIs available after API 10. A162 knowledge-retriever (API usage, version support) — yes. A148 V1→V2 migration — user asks differences between V2 and V1 @Observed; knowledge verification, not migration. Hmm, "和 V1 的 @Observed 有什么区别" — A148 helps with decorator migration including explanations? A209 api-change-guide — API version changes (which APIs since API 10) — yes, "哪些 API 从 API 10 之后才有" is exactly api-change-guide. A154 arkts-sta-spec — type-safety spec, less relevant. Accept A148, A162, A209? A148 is migration skill; question is conceptual comparison. I'd accept A162, A209 and... A148 trigger is migration project. User doesn't want code changes. Marginal. First rater included A148, A162, A209. I'll go with that (A148 explains V2 decorators and V1 differences).

h040-prompt: fix strict compile errors arkts-strict-typing etc. A151 direct, A149 (fix compile errors workflow), A154 spec reference. A154 is a reference skill for reading/writing ArkTS — genuinely serves understanding rules? The request is to fix errors. A154 is reference; borderline. Accept A149, A151.

h043-prompt: camera selection, foldable rotation/stride, hardware capability fallback → A174 core. A173 fold-state (foldable adaptation) — foldable camera rotation/stride when unfolded: A173 covers foldable adaptation including these? A174 description mentions "camera selection" and hardware capability. A173 fold-state: "foldable-device adaptation for requirements, development, bug-fix, verification". The rotation/stride on unfold could involve both. A177 scenario-entry "task broadly concerns HarmonyOS multi-device adaptation, task involves f..." — entry skill for broad multi-device tasks. This is a broad multi-device task. Accept A173, A174, A177.

h044-prompt: Python→functional Scala. A237 direct, A224 idioms (goal is idiomatic? "改写成函数式的 Scala 风格" — functional style). A237 core. A224 "clean idiomatic Scala" — serves. A234 syntax mapping, A256 collections — also serve translation. All genuinely serve? A234 "Reference guide for translating Python syntax constructs to Scala equivalents" — yes serves. A256 collections — the code uses dicts, lists, sorted, set — yes serves. Accept A224, A234, A237, A256? At most 8. The first rater accepted A224, A237. Including more is fine if genuinely serves. I'll accept all four.

h045-prompt: pending review, add comments, submit later → A019 (create pending), A008 (add comment to pending), A089 (write create/submit), A110 (submit pending). All serve. Accept A008, A019, A089, A110.

h055-prompt: list tags, confirm latest release version → A080 list_tags, A043 get_latest_release. A075 list_releases — also can confirm latest released version. Accept A043, A075, A080.

h056-prompt: TCP connections, handshake duration, retransmissions from pcap with Python. A232 (analyzing PCAPs and computing network statistics using Python) — direct. A400 tshark triage — protocol-level details; could extract handshakes/retransmissions but it's tshark-based not Python. Request says "用什么Python方法". A400 is not Python. Accept A232 only.

h057-prompt: quadrotor sim: thrust/moments → motor RPM via allocation (A253), first-order motor response, RK45 integrate translational/rotational dynamics, hover 10s results. A239 attitude-controller is inner control loop PID — not requested (given desired thrust/moments directly). A322 plot-quadrotor "visualising drone simulation results" — user wants simulation results, not plots. Accept A253 only.

h063-prompt: pull comments from a discussion → need to find discussion ID: A065 list_discussions, A036 get_discussion_comments. A035 get_discussion by ID — could be used to verify/fetch the discussion. All serve. Accept A035, A036, A065.

h065-prompt: multi-device adaptation, foldable reflow, camera area (avoid areas). A177 entry, A173 fold-state, A172 avoid-areas. A178 screen-window-size — layout doesn't reflow when screen unfolds... A178 covers 平行视界/分栏/多窗口 — reflow on unfold is fold-state (A173). A178 triggers include window size adaptation? Its triggers are specific: 比价/分屏/平行视界. Not general reflow. Accept A172, A173, A177.

h081-prompt: 40+ files sequential remediation, batching, context overload → A197 exact. A198 log-security-remediation — user's remediation is unifying error handler logging output; A198 is about user data log level — different. Accept A197 only.

h083-prompt: create HarmonyOS skill with guided requirements → A200. A139 skill-creator — general skill creation; A200 is HarmonyOS-specific and explicitly triggers on "创建鸿蒙 skill". A139 could also serve (creating skills generally). Genuinely serves? Yes, skill-creator guides creating any skill. Accept A139, A200.

h086-prompt: UI automation on real device, click, screenshots per step → A202 (autotest, screenshot verification), A161 (verify, UI automation, screenshots). A201 harmonyos-ui-verify — requirement/design/app comparison with semantic assertions and screenshots — this is settings app testing, not app under development UI verification. Marginal. A161 + A202 suffice. A201 is for verifying app UI against design; testing settings app isn't that. Accept A161, A202.

h087-prompt: end-to-end delivery of new module from PRD in HarmonyOS → A157 exact. A143 create-story (requirements design doc) — part of flow but A157 covers end-to-end including requirement analysis. A143 generates design docs — could serve the design phase. Hmm. A212 test case design — part of delivery? A157 is the end-to-end skill. A143 and A212 serve sub-parts genuinely. I'd accept A157 only? "acceptable = every handle that genuinely serves" — A143 creates requirement design document which is part of "需求分析、设计" phase. It genuinely serves. A212 converts approved requirement docs to test cases — also part of e2e. But risk of over-inclusion. The flow "需求分析、设计到编码" — A143 covers requirement/design docs. I'll accept A143, A157, A212? Lean to A157 only being safest, but A143 clearly serves the design doc part. I'll accept A157 and A143? Hmm. A157 description: "覆盖鸿蒙应用需求开发流程。在用户要落地新功能/新页面/新模块、PRD、端到端需求开发" — exact. Sub-skills serve sub-tasks. I'll accept A157, A143, A212 as the second rater — no wait, first rater only A157. The disagreement: does A143/A212 genuinely serve? A212: "把 Approved 需求文档转化为完整测试用例集" — the request includes full e2e delivery, which would include test cases? It says "从需求分析、设计到编码" — no testing mentioned. Drop A212. A143: creates 需求设计文档 covering 功能描述、场景分析、接口设计 — design phase serves. Accept A143, A157.

h088-prompt: freeze at startup, hilog+HiviewDFX logs, error 801, structured report. A181 (error codes 801, root cause with source, structured report) — direct. A186 appfreeze (freeze faultlogs ANR) — user reports occasional freeze. A159 hilog analysis — logs are hilog. Which genuinely serve? Core ask: 定位根因 with 801 error code → A181. Freeze diagnosis → A186. A159 is hilog viewing/crash analysis — also serves log analysis. Hmm. The request: "app 启动偶尔 freeze... 有个 801 的错误码，帮我结合源码定位根因，结构化诊断报告". A181 outputs structured diagnosis report with error code mapping + root cause — perfect. A186 analyzes APPFREEZE faultlogs — the logs are hilog+HiviewDFX, freeze fault — serves. A159 hilog log analysis — serves viewing hilog but the diagnosis path is A181. I'll accept A181, A186.
